messages:
Alex R: Quick note: ran onboarding sampleapp with defaults and hit a retry pile-up. 429s then retries stacked and node process spiked. Repro attached.

Alex R: Repro: npm start (defaults), spawn 30 workers that paginate + call embed/generate. Observed rapid retries and multiple token refreshes.

Priya K: Sounds like two issues: token-refresh stampede and retry recursion that bypasses concurrency gate. Can you paste the retry snippet?

Alex R: current code does immediate recursive retry: `if (isRetryable) return await fetchPage(cursor)` which re-enters without acquiring the semaphore.

Diego M: That recursion multiplies attempts. Fix: change retries to an explicit loop that acquires/releases the same semaphore per attempt and use exp backoff + jitter. Also ensure auth.getToken is single-flight.

Priya K: SDK parity: JS has single-flight refresh, but Py/Go examples still call refresh per request. I'll open parity PRs to add an in-flight promise pattern and Config.MaxConcurrentSequences default=12.

Alex R: I tested lowering default concurrency from 100->12 and changing retry to loop + acquire before each retry. Burst no longer caused OOM.

Diego M: Add a CLI flag `--burst-safe` (default on for local quickstart) and a warning if user sets concurrency>64 without it. Emit telemetry sdk.client.refresh.inflight_max and sdk.client.retry.queue_depth so hosted can detect stampedes.

onboard-bot: Created ticket ONB-5001: "onboard: retry-queue + SDK refresh parity + burst-safe defaults" assigned to Priya K, Diego M.

Alex R: Action items: Priya -> parity PRs; Diego -> sampleapp retry-loop + CLI warning; Alex -> attach repro + flamegraph to ONB-5001.

Priya K: I'll add a small integration test that simulates token expiry under burst to assert only one refresh runs.

Diego M: I'll land sampleapp change and add docs blurb in quickstart.

Alex R: Thanks team :thumbsup:
